After the version 1.7 update, Sixteen Lanes observed and fixed the following issues: 
[1] Fixed an issue where the "Camel" at Camel Station could be harvested repeatedly to quickly gain large amounts of "Camel Milk." 
[2] Fixed an issue in some modes where "Golden Cup Birds" could be repeatedly refreshed to quickly gain large amounts of "Golden Cup Fragments" and "Five-Colored Glaze." There is a cap on these items; the fix does not affect the daily obtain limit. 
Additionally, Sixteen Lanes noted that the acquisition of "Camel Milk" needed optimization and made the following changes: 
[1] The monster "Wutu" will drop "Camel Milk" upon death. 
[2] "Camel Milk" can now be obtained in the Hexi Co-op World, with a refresh time of 5 minutes. 
[3] The number of "Camels" available for harvesting "Camel Milk" will be increased in the future. 
We deeply apologize for the inconvenience caused by the anomaly and offer this #4d734dsmall gift#E as a token of our regret. The quantity of compensated "Camel Milk" is based on the#H total obtained#E before the fix, ensuring fairness for all Wanderers. 
Thank you for your understanding and support of Where Winds Meet. If you have further questions or needs, you may click to visit [Link] for assistance, or call our dedicated service line at 95163988. May your journey through the Jianghu be filled with joy, and may all things go better than you wish.
